canonical_name: No Infrastructure and Software Change Management
description: The entity does not authorize, design, develop or acquire, configure, document, test, approve, and implement changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures to meet its objectives.
applicability: Change control processes, software development lifecycle

metadata.detection_notes: Review change management processes, change request documentation, approval workflows, testing procedures, and deployment controls. Verify changes are authorized, tested, and documented.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC8 Change Management
